column1: # doc-markers.tsv — the MARKER TABLE read by conformance/doc-markers.sh.
# Each data line is ONE load-bearing marker: a tracked document must carry a phrase, and the check
# names that marker when it goes missing. The table is the check's whole subject — the script has no
# per-case knowledge at all — so adding a marker is a table row, never a new conformance/*.sh.
# FORMAT — one row per marker, exactly FIVE tab-separated fields. `#` comments and blank lines skipped.
#     <case>\t<file>\t<regex>\t<label>\t<scope>
#   case   the check name a verify.sh row and CI step invoke: `sh conformance/doc-markers.sh <case>`.
#   file   repo-root-relative path of the document that must carry the marker.
#   regex  POSIX ERE, CASE-SENSITIVE (grep -Eq). Escape ERE metacharacters you mean literally.
#   label  the human name of the marker. It is the FAIL text (`FAIL: <label> (missing in <file>)`)
#          AND the string --selftest requires the mutant to die by, so a label is load-bearing
#          identity, not decoration: two rows must never share one.
#   scope  `kit` — the document is the kit's OWN, so the case renders N/A on an adopter tree (no
#                  docs/ROADMAP-KIT.md and none of the case's files present).
#          `any` — the document is expected wherever the check runs; absence is a FAIL.
# --selftest generates, for EVERY row, a mutant that strips the matching lines from a fixture copy
# and requires RED WITH THAT ROW'S LABEL. So a row that cannot be killed is a row that is not really
# checked, and the sweep says which one.
# ── artifact-lineage (E11) — templates/AI-ARTIFACT-LINEAGE-TEMPLATE.md still carries its six
#    load-bearing fields: the chain tying a produced AI artifact back to the model + prompt + inputs
#    + eval that made it. HONEST CEILING: the phrases are matched, so this proves the FIELDS are
#    present, never that they are FILLED, nor that a real artifact's stated lineage is accurate
#    (that is the signer's responsibility).

# ── dod-precedence (DOD-SINGLE-SOURCE, PR 9 / D-240828-4) — DEVELOPMENT-STANDARDS.md §12 is the ONE
#    drift-capable restatement of the Definition of Done in the shipped tree (it lists category
#    names, not items) and it opens by DEFERRING to CLAUDE.md. This row pins that deferral in its
#    exact bold-backticked form, so deleting or REWORDING it — turning the restatement back into an
#    apparently-authoritative second source — reds CI with this row's label. The regex escapes `**`
#    and the `.` deliberately: the unescaped form matches a bold-stripped or reworded line too, and
#    the generated mutant battery cannot tell the weak regex from the strong one (both kill the
#    deletion mutant), so the build carries a bold-stripped negative fixture beyond the battery.
#    Scope `any`: `git archive HEAD` measured both documents SHIPPING to adopter trees (2026-08-31),
#    where the precedence rule is exactly as load-bearing.
#    HONEST CEILING: this pins PRECEDENCE, not content agreement. If CLAUDE.md adds or renames a DoD
#    category, §12's category prose can drift silently — the deferral is what makes that drift
#    harmless, because the restatement permanently declares itself subordinate.
dod-precedence
column4: dod-precedence: standards §12 defers to the authoritative checklist

column1: # ── collected-not-gated (PREFLIGHT-DOCTOR-MERGE disposition, PR 9 / D-240828-4) — the three
#    measurement instruments each carry a header disclosure stating plainly that they are exercised
#    by selftests (agent-scorecard.sh: plus one golden-path run), that NO CI gate consumes their
#    output, and that they are run deliberately. Removing a disclosure reds CI with that
#    instrument's label, so the honesty is ENFORCED rather than merely declared. Scope `any`:
#    `git archive HEAD` measured all three scripts SHIPPING to adopter trees (2026-08-31).
#    The pattern is ANCHORED to `^# collected-not-gated:` — the bare token was satisfiable by ANY
#    occurrence in the file (a mention in prose, a variable name), so the anchor is what makes the
#    row assert the DISCLOSURE LINE rather than the word.
#    HONEST CEILING: proves the disclosure LINE is present, never that it is TRUE — whether the
#    instruments stay ungated is a property of ci.yml/verify.sh that no marker can see.
#    SCOPE CONSEQUENCE (`any`, owner-ratified trade): an adopter who LEGITIMATELY deletes one of these
#    instruments (dora.sh on a non-GitHub host, say) gets a hard RED from a disclosure check that has
#    no waiver arm. Deliberate: the alternative — latching to N/A on absence — is a check that fails
#    open exactly when a file goes missing.
collected-not-gated
